newsitem.title: USA: Layne Christensen to reduce debt.
newsitem.headline: Layne Christensen to reduce debt.

text.p: Layne Christensen Co said Monday it will use estimated net proceeds of $31.7 million from the sale of shares to reduce debt incurred in its recent acquisition of Stanley Mining Services Ltd of Australia.
Layne said the five million shares being offered were priced at $17.00 a share. Layne said it is selling 2,006,565 shares and certain selling stockholders will sell 2,993,435 shares.
In June, Layne said it planned to offer up to five million shares of stock to the public, with 1.7 million to be sold by the company and 3.3 million by certain stockholders.
The underwriters were Piper Jaffray Inc and Dillon, Read and Co Inc.

Layne Christensen provides water well drilling, well and pump repair and maintenance, mineral exploration drilling and environmental drilling services. It also makes equipment used by drilling contractors.
